reviews.title: Scammers Applications
reviews.text: I tried this application from website advertisement since offering minimal US$0.5. Nothing much, birth chart you can get from many websites for free. Soon after this application try to change to my credit card without my knowledge and consent. 1st try to charge US$49.99 on 14 July 2025, later try to charge US$21.90 on 21 July, US29.90 on 22 July. At this point, I removed the application from my device. This application tried to change US$29.90 on 25 July. I am lucky that I am not provided my credit card information. I paid US$0.5 from Apple Pay. Without my pin input this stupid application can’t change to the card. If you continue trying this I will make police report and will request to remove from application stores.

reviews.title: Kinda scammy, not worth it.
reviews.text:
The app’s “psychics” and chats claims to help serve you, but they deduct credits by the minute - so if they don’t reply you, you “pay” without getting an answer. Tried out of curiosity but feels like I could go on chatgpt to get the same answers 😂 will verify that and update!

Also they ask for a lot of personal info and credit card upfront - not worth it.

Go to astrowin.org instead so much better
